q1.question: What is Midjourney Image to Video?
q1.answer: Midjourney Image to Video converts your uploaded images into video clips with customizable motion, quality, and style parameters using advanced AI technology.

q2.question: What motion settings are available?
q2.answer: You can choose between low and high motion settings to control the intensity of movement in your generated videos.

q3.question: What is the quality parameter?
q3.answer: The quality parameter ranges from 0.25 to 2 and controls image detail and processing time. Higher values produce more detailed results but take longer to process.

q4.question: What are stylize, chaos, and weird parameters?
q4.answer: Stylize (0-1000) controls artistic style, chaos (0-100) adds variety to results, and weird (0-3000) makes images more quirky and unconventional.

q5.question: What resolutions are supported?
q5.answer: Midjourney Image to Video supports 480p and 720p resolutions. Choose the resolution that best matches your project requirements.
